# The drops' resolve read in the live app after the mend

Build: 725c01b with a read added after the blit in resolveBehind (not committed). Page: the built app, ?quality=high&season=spring, fresh page, headless Chromium, 1280x720 at 1x, then one resize of the window to 1100x640.
Each line: frame of the page, size of the target, gl.getError(), then RGBA at five points (x = 1/6..5/6 of the width, y = 0.6 of the height) of the resolve texture the drops look through.
